newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegalese students ends class boycott.
newsitem.headline: Senegalese students ends class boycott.

text.p: Students at Senegal's Dakar university ended their week-long boycott of classes on Friday.
The students were boycotting classes for better working and living conditions. Students clashed violently on Thursday with riot police whom they want to oust from the campus.
"Our talks with the university authorities are promising, that's why we have decided to end the class boycott," one student said.
